mainEntity.name: What is acrylic stucco and how does it differ from traditional stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Acrylic stucco, also known as synthetic stucco or EIFS (Exterior Insulation and Finish System), is a multi-layered wall system that offers a durable and flexible finish. Unlike traditional cement-based stucco, acrylic stucco uses an acrylic polymer as its binding agent. This makes it more resistant to cracking, fading, and moisture penetration. It also provides better insulation properties due to its integrated foam board layer, contributing to improved energy efficiency for your property. Traditional stucco is harder, more brittle, and typically less insulative.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acrylic stucco is a flexible, polymer-based exterior finish that offers superior crack resistance, color retention, and insulation compared to traditional cement stucco.
